svg.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next DSpark Fixed mask versus Baseline training loss and accuracy

cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next DSpark Fixed mask versus Baseline training loss and accuracy
cc:Work.dc:description: Raw exported train/loss and train/acc without smoothing. Maximum x-axis step is 4000, the smaller final step of Fixed mask (4000) and Baseline (26040). Only recorded points at or below 4000 are plotted; the final available Baseline point within that range is 3920. Repeated steps retain the latest wall-time record.
